drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop instrumental. 85 BPM, 4/4 time signature, key of C minor. The track features a dusty, sampled drum break with a prominent, slightly muffled kick and a crisp snare with a short decay. A warm, saturated electric bass plays a syncopated two-bar loop emphasizing the root and fifth. A clean electric guitar performs a repetitive four-chord progression using jazz voicings with a subtle chorus effect and high-frequency roll-off. A Rhodes-style electric piano provides rhythmic stabs on the off-beats. A recurring melodic motif is played by a muted trumpet with a heavy hall reverb. Vinyl crackle and low-level atmospheric hiss are layered throughout the arrangement. The arrangement follows an additive structure, layering the melodic elements over the established drum and bass loop.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and hiss]
[clean electric guitar chords with chorus]
[dusty drum break enters]

[Main Theme]
[syncopated electric bass enters]
[Rhodes piano off-beat stabs]
[muted trumpet melody with heavy reverb]

[Bridge]
[trumpet and Rhodes drop out]
[guitar continues with filtered bass]

[Outro]
[drums drop out]
[sustained guitar chord fades into vinyl crackle]
